$comment: Corrections to the compatibility data that scripts/bindings/web-availability.mjs reads, for `lasm build --target`'s check (docs/JS_BINDINGS.md, "Availability per target"). Each entry: the API's compatibility path (api.Window.navigator) or Lean name, the runtimes it corrects, `available`, why, a link (the upstream report, or Lasm's evidence), and its decision in docs/api/decisions/0.3.md.

overrides.why: the global navigator: the data records it under api.Navigator for these runtimes (BCD: Node 21; runtime-compat: Bun, workerd), not under Window; js-web conformance reads navigator.userAgent on each
workerd constructs MessageChannel; js-web conformance posts a structured clone through one on workerd
Bun 1.4.4 (Lasm's pinned Bun) constructs File; the data describes Bun 1.3.3
Bun 1.4.4 constructs CompressionStream (the data lists the interface on Bun but not its constructor)
Bun 1.4.4 constructs DecompressionStream (the data lists the interface on Bun but not its constructor)
Bun 1.4.4 (Lasm's pinned Bun) has URLPattern; the data describes Bun 1.3.3
WebAssembly.CompileError is part of every engine's WebAssembly; runtime-compat lists no WebAssembly error classes
